theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (cJ σ κ M : ℝ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (W ζ : Rn n → ℝ) (j : Fin ℓ), 0 ≤ cJ → 0 < σ → 0 ≤ κ → κ ≤ 1 → LipschitzOnWith 1 f (closedBall 0 (σ / 2)) → Measurable W → (∀ᵐ x ∂(volume : Measure (Rn n)), x ∈ ball 0 (3 * σ / 8) → W x = 0 ∨ (1 ≤ W x ∧ W x ≤ (1 + κ) * (1 + cJ * hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x)))) → (∀ x, ‖gradient ζ x‖ ≤ M) → |(∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 4), inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => f y j) x) (gradient ζ x)) - ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 4), inner ℝ (gradient (fun y => f y j) x) (gradient ζ x) * W x| ≤ M * (volume (ball (0 : Rn n) (3 * σ / 8) ∩ {x | W x = 0})).toReal + M * κ * (∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 4), ‖gradient (fun y => f y j) x‖) + 2 * cJ * M * ∫ x in ball (0 : Rn n) (σ / 4), hsNormSq (fderiv ℝ f x)
